questions.question: In a psalm calling all creation to praise the LORD, who in the heavens is first told to praise Him?
In a psalm calling creation to praise the LORD, why are the angels, sun, moon and stars told to praise Him?

answers.text: He commanded and they were created
They were made to serve people
They live closest to His throne

questions.question: In a psalm calling all creation to praise the LORD, what is the powerful wind said to be doing?
At the end of a psalm calling creation to praise the LORD, how is His people Israel described?

answers.text: A people sent to the nations
